title: ext.foobench (docs/architecture D.12.2, C.10)
description: Closed schema of the `foobench` ext namespace. `events` keeps every event the adapter cannot map (a checkpoint_restore, an unknown type) verbatim, in the `ext` of the nearest preceding host record, and is never dropped. `verdict_raw` keeps a guard or approval string that is outside the profile's closed verdict table. Evidence for ext values is addressed through `evf` pointers /ext/foobench/... (C.10 item 6); PROV does not read it.

value.description: The event's other members, verbatim (encoded as AER Json, C.11).

a.description: Raw artefact id; absent for the primary file (a0).

after.description: Immediate predecessors, in the form of the AER `after` edge: the host record the event followed in source order.

verdict_raw.description: A guard verdict or approval decision outside the profile's closed table, verbatim; the decision's verdict is then declared unknown (ambiguous).
